designer.name: Maya Lin
designer.availability: Available for Select Contract Engagements & Design Audits
designer.tagline: Crafting resilient digital product experiences, scalable multi-brand design systems, and delightful human interactions.
designer.bio: Over the past 9 years, I have architected digital products for fintech unicorns, enterprise SaaS platforms, and early-stage startups. My focus unites rigorous user research, systematic component architectures, and micro-interaction polish.

caseStudies.title: VaultPay — Autonomous Global Treasury App
caseStudies.summary: Redesigning international cross-border liquidity management for high-growth tech enterprises.
caseStudies.challenge: Fragmented financial dashboards led to 34% drop-off during cross-border settlement approvals.
caseStudies.solution: Engineered an intelligent batch-approval interface reducing settlement latency from 4.2 minutes to 28 seconds.

caseStudies.title: Prism Multi-Brand Design System
caseStudies.summary: Unified 4 legacy corporate brands under a tokenized WCAG 2.1 AAA accessible system.
caseStudies.challenge: 4 distinct enterprise engineering squads had duplicated 210+ button and input variations with zero code alignment.
caseStudies.solution: Built a centralised token library syncing Figma variables directly with Style Dictionary into React and Flutter repos.

caseStudies.title: Orbit AI — Intelligent Codebase Copilot
caseStudies.summary: Human-in-the-loop conversational interface for automated code refactoring and AST visualization.
caseStudies.challenge: Complex automated diff proposals confused non-senior engineers, causing rejection of correct suggestions.
caseStudies.solution: Designed contextual inline side-by-side AST visualizers with multi-stage approval granularity.

process.title: Discovery & Behavioral Ethnography
process.description: Stakeholder immersion, cognitive walkthroughs, user interviews, and friction mapping across the user lifecycle.

process.title: Information Architecture & Low-Fi
process.description: Tree testing, user journey blueprints, and rapid wireframing to resolve structural complexity before styling.

process.title: Tokenized Systems & Micro-Interactions
process.description: Component tokenization, accessibility audits, typography scales, and tactile motion design.

process.title: Validation & Engineering Handoff
process.description: Usability testing rounds, interactive prototypes, edge-case documentation, and Storybook code pairing.

testimonials.quote: Maya transformed our chaotic platform into a benchmark of elegant usability. Her deep understanding of design tokens saved our engineering department hundreds of hours.
testimonials.author: Samantha Vance

testimonials.quote: One of the most methodical and visionary designers I've collaborated with. Maya doesn't just make things look gorgeous; she solves real business problems.
testimonials.author: Julian Meyer
